title: Federal reserve data on fab utilization
text:
A

Ashwin Rao
New member

Saw this post on X: Not sure how this data gets compiled nor its validity. This data is interesting though from a risk perspective - Production rates need to go up faster for fabs to be generating economic returns but we have hit an implementation capacity wall for downstream consumers of chips (regulatory approvals, labor availability, utility availability) - As a wise man once said - Interesting times indeed

us chip plants just printed their biggest month of output on record and they're running at 2017 utilisation rates.the fed's capacity index for semiconductors and electronic components is up 80% since february 2022 and output is up 41%, so utilisation went 92.2% to 72.2%. pic.twitter.com/AqHTfYoPm7— Haircut (@nodiligence) August 18, 2026
